findings.evidence: `pkg/ddl/backfilling_operators.go:550` now buffers `idxResults` (appends every fetched `*chunk.Chunk` at `pkg/ddl/backfilling_operators.go:577`) and only calls `sender(...)` after `wrapInBeginRollback(...)` completes (`pkg/ddl/backfilling_operators.go:584`). Each `TableScanTask` is a PD-region key range (`pkg/ddl/backfilling_operators.go:272`), produced via `loadTableRanges` using `BatchLoadRegionsWithKeyRange` (`pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:486`, `pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:527`). Operator wiring uses an unbuffered channel (`pkg/disttask/operator/compose.go:30`), so the previous “send-per-chunk” design applied tight backpressure; this change allows scanning to materialize an entire region’s worth of chunks in memory before any writer receives them. Reader concurrency can exceed writer concurrency based on avg row size (`pkg/ddl/backfilling_txn_executor.go:349`).
findings.fix: Bound per-task buffering: split `TableScanTask` into smaller key ranges than a full PD region (so each task produces a small, predictable number of chunks), or add an explicit memory/row-count cap that forces re-splitting/yielding when exceeded.
findings.impact: On large/wide tables with many regions and higher reorg concurrency, concurrent scan workers can retain multiple full-region scan outputs in Go heap, causing multi-GB memory spikes, long GC pauses, or OOM/crash during ADD INDEX ingest (availability and DDL stability risk).
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed up to `upstream/master` (`bab4993b6fd61de478062151bb615a0e09c0aecb`): `pkg/ddl/backfilling_operators.go` still buffers per-task scan results and only sends them after the scan transaction finishes, preserving the same full-task buffering behavior.
findings.verify: Stress a large multi-region table (wide rows) with elevated `@@tidb_ddl_reorg_worker_cnt`, run ADD INDEX in ingest mode, and monitor TiDB heap/GC (pprof/memstats) to confirm memory stays bounded and the DDL completes without OOM/regressions.
findings.what: Potential large memory spike/OOM risk: table scan now buffers all result chunks for a PD-region-sized `TableScanTask` before sending to writers, removing the prior streaming/backpressure behavior.

subject: ddl: send result chunks to writers after scan task complete (#62014)
summary: Moves `TableScanOperator` to buffer per-task scan chunks and only deliver them to writers after the scan transaction finishes; adds/adjusts failpoints and a realtikv test to assert no scan transaction is in-flight during local-engine import.
